instruction: I am looking to purchase a ProForm Pro 2000 Treadmill on Amazon, but it is pricey! I have inquired with my siblings and coworkers on phone for any promo codes. Please check for replies, apply codes, if any, and complete the purchase with the best discount.
notes: Two apps (phone, amazon) plus supervisor. The two contact groups named in the instruction (siblings, coworkers) are declared as domain constants of type relationship so that applying the promo code can require both groups' replies to have been checked without quantifiers. phone-search-contacts(relationship) discovers each group's contacts; phone-search-text-messages for a group stands for querying the messages of each contact of that group (phone_number taken from the contact search) and collecting all promo codes in the replies. The single promo-code object best-promo-code abstracts the runtime choice of the code with the largest discount (the agent may apply several candidates and compare show_cart discounts; the best one must be the one left applied). The product is added with clear_cart_first=true so the resulting order has exactly one treadmill with quantity 1. amazon-show-cart verifies the applied discount before amazon-place-order, which uses an existing payment card and existing address (addresses must not be modified). supervisor-complete-task carries the product and promo-code records, requires the order to be placed, and is the only action that sets task-completed; all other actions require (not (task-completed)).
